description: A men's T20 player's current form against their own career average (red-hot to out-of-form), their bowling workload, and their last five appearances, for 2,739 established players through 17 Sep 2026. Measured: players carrying "red-hot" into a match scored 11% above their own average in it; "out-of-form" 5% below. Per call.

player.description: The player's name as match records write it, e.g. "V Kohli". Part of a name matches; the answer names who was used and who else matched.

name: hsh-cricket-form
